resources.string: This app shows upcoming events from calendars that are already synced to this device. It needs read access to your calendars. Event data stays on the device.
Calendar access was denied. You can allow it in the app settings.
Calendar access is granted. To add an agenda: long-press an empty area of your home screen, choose Widgets, then Family Calendar Widget.
No internet access, analytics or tracking. Calendar data is read on the device only.
Built with AndroidX (Jetpack Compose, Glance, WorkManager, DataStore), Kotlin and kotlinx.serialization, all licensed under the Apache License 2.0.
No calendars found on this device. Add an account in the system settings and sync its calendars, then come back.
Shows events whose title contains any keyword. Leave empty to show all events.
Upcoming events from selected calendars, filtered by keywords
